items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: My mother's name was Julia Groeter

ctx.x: It might help to stick to where we are for the time being. We'll have to make sure you get into that. One thing before we go any further, what were your parents' names?
My mother's name was Julia Groeter, it was Swiss; and my
father's name was August Sauter; he was German.
